This '''''Lucrehulk''-class battleship''' participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="ROTS" /> During the engagement, the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Lucrehulk]] caught a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] in-between its docking arms. The captive Venator docked with the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and offloaded teams of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] whom tore through its corridors.<ref name="Ships Aplenty">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/production/f20050526|text=Episode III Easter Egg Hunt: Ships Aplenty}}</ref> During [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] attempt to rescue the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]], the clone soldiers had successfully captured the Lucrehulk.<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|There's so much happening high above Coruscant that it's hard to single out one spectacle not to miss. There's a very intriguing tangle that has a triangular Republic destroyer caught within the arms of a massive ring-shaped Trade Federation battleship. It's hard to tell what's happening here: perhaps the Federation ship has somehow captured the Republic vessel in its clutches. According to the Animatics Department that plotted out the space battle, the Republic ship is docked with a captive donut ship, and teams of clone troopers are tearing through the corridors.|From the 'Ships Aplenty' segmement of the Episode III Easter Egg Hunt article on StarWars.com|<ref name="Ships Aplenty" />}}
[[File:Friendlucrehulk.png|thumb|left|255px|Republic-aligned ''Lucrehulk''-class battleship]]
During the opening sequence of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] which encompasses the Battle of Coruscant, a Lucrehulk appears with a Venator between its [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bay]] arms as Obi-Wan maneuvers to escape from a pair of [[Discord missile/Legends|discord missiles]] fired upon him and Anakin earlier. The two vessels are visible near the bottom left whilst a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyer]] collides with a [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]].

It was revealed in the [[StarWars.com]] article, Episode III Easter Egg Hunt, that while plotting out the space battle, the Animatics Department for the film intended for this particular Lucrehulk to be in the midst of a boarding conducted by clones from the docked Venator.<ref name="Ships Aplenty" /> The [[2005]] edition of the reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], published on [[October 17]] of that year, includes the two ships on a diagram of the Battle of Coruscant, approximately within the location corresponding to where they appear on-screen in the film. Directly above the diagram illustrations is an infobox which features a film still of the starships without debris obscuring them as they are within the theatrical cut and subsequent releases. The map color-coded the Lucrehulk as being a Republic-aligned ship, thus confirming the clones were successful in capturing the ship.<ref name="Complete Locations" />
